the present sol–gel processing of nanocrystelline proton conducting Ba(Zr0.8 Y0.2)O3 − d (BZY20), using all-alkoxides route, has been successfully demonstrated to be an effective and low temperature processing technique for producing nanosized BZY20 powders.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sol–gel method is an efficient method to produce nanocrystallites of proton conducting BZY20 at very low crystallization temperatures.
the sol–gel method can be applied to the synthesis of oxide protonic nanomaterials with a low crystallization temperature.
the sol–gel method can be successfully used to synthesize the proton conducting BZY20 ceramic materials in nanosized form at very low crystallization temperatures.

the low temperature sol–gel synthesis can be successfully used to prepare nanocrystallite BZY20 protonic ceramic powders with a very high density of protonic defects.
